question: What yogic mastery and strength are affirmed in these divine epithets?
premises: The deity is the yogin of the imperishable chariot
The deity is the yogin of all
inference: The deity embodies universal yogic mastery supported by great strength.
uncertainties: akṣara+tha may be read as imperishable chariot or require alternative segmentation
plain_english: Obeisance to the yogin of the imperishable chariot; obeisance to the yogin of all; obeisance to the one of great strength.
